ImageDescription.value:
Na na na na na?

Be the ball Johnny?.

With Bill Murray on the field, the audience shout-outs are a reply of Caddyshack, and he plays the part. Here he is trying to signal the ball to go closer to the pin? Cindarella story?. outta nowhere?. former greenskeeper about to become the Masters champion.

When his ball stopped just short of the hole, he went through pained histrionics, stumbling and dragging his putter behind him like a rake? and pulling the ball in behind him for a no-look gimme.
